item.title: Every job in your business fits in one of four boxes.
item.description:
Every job in your business fits in one of four boxes. This comes from Dan Martell's book Buy Back Your Time.
D - Delegation: low money, drains you. Returning missed calls. R - Replacement: makes money, drains you. Chasing quotes. I - Investment: low money, gives you energy. Family, health, learning. P - Production: high money, gives you energy. Doing the job. Closing the sale.
Which box did you spend most of today in?
(We are not affiliated with or endorsed by Dan Martell.)

The 7-Day Missed-Call Pilot.

item.title: When you are on a job and the phone rings, what happens to that caller?
item.description:
Quick question for business owners.
When you are on a job and the phone rings, what happens to that caller?
A) They leave a voicemail B) They call back later C) They call someone else
Be honest. Drop your letter in the comments.
